title: Inspiration
subtitle: Upload a photo of a look you like and AI will break it down item by item.

empty.title: No inspiration looks yet
empty.description: Upload a photo of an outfit you like -- from a shop, a magazine, social media -- and AI will identify each piece.

upload.title: Upload an inspiration look
upload.description: AI will identify each garment in the photo. You can correct any tag afterwards.
upload.dropzone: Drag a photo here, or click to choose one
upload.formatHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to {maxMb}MB

detail.analyzing: AI is identifying the items in this photo...
detail.retryHint: Delete this look and upload the photo again to retry.
detail.noItems: No items were identified in this photo.
detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this inspiration look? The photo and its analyzed items will be permanently removed.
detail.notMatchedYet: This look hasn't been matched against your wardrobe yet.
detail.matchError: Couldn't match the look against your wardrobe.
detail.deleteItemConfirm: Remove this piece from the look?

match.nothingPicked: No piece picked -- this one is left out.
match.pickerTitle: Choose a piece from your wardrobe
match.pickerDescription: Pick what you'd wear in place of this piece.
match.pickerEmpty: No pieces of this type in your wardrobe.
match.rematchConfirm: Match this look against your wardrobe again? Pieces you picked by hand will be replaced by the new best matches.

recreate.title: Restyle this look
recreate.summary: {picked} of {total} pieces picked from your wardrobe
recreate.description: Creates a new outfit from the picked pieces. You can accept or reject it like any other suggestion.
recreate.name: Name (optional)

addItem.title: Add a piece
addItem.description: Add a piece the AI missed. You can refine its tags afterwards.
